jobs.title: CAD Administrator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Role**

As an NX Cad Admin / Triage support at Anduril, you will be instrumental in establishing, maintaining, and optimizing the Siemens NX CAD environment that powers our engineering and manufacturing teams. You will support the organization and its users on the day to day activities by working side-by-side with all of our users to support their needs, ensuring that designers and engineers have reliable, performant, and standardized tools to rapidly innovate. Your expertise will directly contribute to our ability to design, iterate, and deliver cutting-edge defense solutions at speed and scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop, implement, monitor, and optimize the Siemens NX CAD environment, including templates, customization files, role-based configurations, and default settings across the organization.
* Provide specialized technical support for CAD software applications used by our design and engineering teams (e.g., [NX, SolidWorks]).
* Manage the incoming IT helpdesk queue [e.g., Jira Service Desk], ensuring tickets are triaged, categorized, and assigned correctly.
* Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support tickets related to CAD/PLM software issues.
* Meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times.
* Onboard new hires by setting up CAD-capable workstations, user accounts, and software permissions.
* Create, organize, and maintain user-facing self-service documentation and internal IT knowledge base articles.
* Provide technical leadership and structured training to engineering and design teams; mentor less experienced users and serve as the primary point of escalation for NX-related issues.
* Coordinate configuration and improvement projects with engineering, manufacturing, IT, quality, and Siemens/external service providers; act as the technical point of contact for significant CAD/PLM issues.
* Lead or champion reliability, capability, and continuous improvement projects related to the CAD/PLM environment; quantify benefits, document outcomes, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Ensure CAD configuration activities comply with site security, quality, and regulatory standards; assess and mitigate operational and data-security risks related to the engineering toolset.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Associate degree or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Drafting/Design, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an IT helpdesk/technical support role.
* CAD Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience supporting or directly using CAD platforms (NX, SolidWorks) in a professional environment.
* Working knowledge interpreting NX Logs/Sys Logs
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of the organization.
* Problem-Solving: Excellent troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex software conflicts.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex technical issues to both highly technical engineers and non-technical staff.
* Customer Service: A patient, empathetic, and helpful attitude toward end-users under tight deadlines.
* Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of tickets while prioritizing critical CAD-stoppage issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience administering Teamcenter PLM, including workflow, BOM, and access configuration.
* Multi-skilled experience administering and configuring Siemens NX with advanced troubleshooting capability across CAD, CAM, and CAE environments.
* Experience configuring NX templates, customization files, role-based settings, and standardized environments for multi-user deployments.
* Capable of obtaining U.S. Secret security clearance

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking infor

jobs.title: Lab Technician - Cal Color
jobs.description:
Job Req ID: 107614

Job Type: Full-time

Work Category: Onsite,

Application Close Date: 10/05/2026

Sponsorship: Not Available

Compensation: $23.08 - $31.15

**We are GALLO**

We’re a family-owned company with a 90+ year legacy, that’s consistently recognized as a Glassdoor “Best Places to Work.” We have 130+ brands in our total alcohol beverage portfolio including wine, malt, spirits, and ready-to-drink beverages. We’re home to the #1 wine and spirits brands in the U.S. - Barefoot Wine & High Noon and are the official sponsors of the NFL, NHL, UFC, and PGA of America.

**A Taste of What You'll Do**

This position supports the product development team by providing general routine assistance and analysis in the lab. Provides technical and application support to the sales and product development teams by evaluating new products and experimental blends through laboratory analysis, experimentation, and food and beverage prototype development. Conducts routine chemical, physical, and instrumental testing; operates, calibrates, and maintains laboratory equipment; manages samples and timely reporting; and documents activities in LIMS as needed. This role also prepares laboratory solutions, handles chemical waste in accordance with guidelines, maintains a clean and safe work environment, supports sampling and special projects, and ensures compliance with applicable quality, environmental, and safety requirements.

**What You'll Need**

* Associate's degree with a minimum of 20 units of completed college level chemistry, biology, microbiology, food science, engineering or related courses; OR High School Diploma or State issued equivalency certificate, plus 2 years of chemistry, microbiology, food science or related laboratory experience reflecting increasing levels of responsibility.
* Required to lift and carry cases of product that can weigh up to 50 pounds.
* Required to conduct work at extreme heights.
* Required to comply with company GMP Policies.
* Required to be at least 18 years of age.
* Required to travel to company offices, sites, and/or meeting locations for onboarding, training, meetings, and events for development, department needs, and business delivery up to 5% of the time, with or without reasonable accommodation. This may be in addition to travel requirements, if applicable, as listed in this job description.
* Required to be 18 years or older. This may be in addition to other age requirements, if applicable, as listed in this job description.

**How You'll Stand Out**

* Bachelors of Science degree in Food Science, Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Viticulture/Enology, or Microbiology; OR High School Diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate, plus 4 years of chemistry, microbiology, food science or related laboratory experience reflecting increasing levels of responsibility

**Our Benefits & Perks**

We are committed to providing competitive compensation, perks, and a culture that supports your well-being. Benefits depend on your work category and may include medical and dental coverage, 401k plans, profit sharing, pet insurance, company holidays, access to an employee wine shop, and more! Additional information will be provided before your first interview.

**The Fine Print**

* The Company does not sponsor for employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.
* We offer a broad salary range to allow for long-term growth. Actual compensation paid within the range will be determined by multiple factors, including, but not limited to, education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed between the entry point and middle of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors. In addition to the salary, this position may be eligible for bonuses, incentive plans, or participate in tasting room tip pools, as applicable.
* This position will be based in the location(s) specified in the job posting and requires working on-site with no telecommuting option. You will be expected to live within a commutable distance.
* It is the Company’s policy for job postings to be open to internal candidates for a minimum of 5 days and to external candidates, if applicable, for a minimum of 3 days.

jobs.title: Dairy Cattle Research and Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Research and laboratory firm based in Tulare, California is looking to hire veterinarians or graduates with a bachelor / master’s in animal science.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

***Research:***

* Experimental treatments administration or supervision of administration.
* Study animals care and handling.
* Clinical evaluation of cattle body systems.
* Measuring of different performance outcomes.
* Biological samples collection and processing.
* Development of data collection forms, entry of data into forms and records maintenance.
* Database building and management.

***Laboratory:***

* Preparation of samples for analysis (ex. plating of milk in culture media, blood centrifugation, etc).
* Identification of bacteria causing mastitis in milk using culture medium and qPCR.
* In vitro simulation of rumen fermentation.
* Timely cleaning and disinfection of the laboratory, as well as handling of biohazard and general waste.

**Qualifications and Skills**

Veterinarian / Bachelor or master’s in animal science.

* Intellectual curiosity with an interest in research.
* Strong **work ethics** and **attention to detail** with a commitment to provide quality results in a timely fashion.
* Highly motivated self-driven professional willing to welcome challenge and overcome adversity with a **positive attitude**.
* Willingness to work overtime, nights or weekends depending on workload demands.
* Languages: English and Spanish.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel and Power-Point).

Job Type: Full-time

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Quality Control Technician, where your keen eye for detail and passion for excellence will drive the integrity of our manufacturing processes. In this vital role, you will ensure that all products meet rigorous quality standards by performing precise inspections, analyzing data, and maintaining compliance with industry regulations. Your expertise will help uphold our commitment to delivering safe, reliable, and high-quality products to our customers worldwide. This position offers an engaging environment where your technical skills and proactive approach will make a real impact every day.

**Duties**

Job descriptionPolycoat Products is looking for a QC Technician to join the Cold Cast team. We are looking for someone who is well organized and is eager to learn and work in a fast-paced industrial environment.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Perform quality control testing on liquid samples created/supplied/manufactured by the production department.
* Calculate test results, log and report results in a timely manner
* Prepare and test analytical measurements such as titrations, moisture content, viscosity etc.
* Calibrate instruments as needed
* Maintaining equipment in proper working order and maintain a clean work area
* Practice safe work habits, including complying with all safety, health, and environmental rules and regulations
* Filing and organize all reports and paperwork pertaining to work

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Chemistry or related field
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Ability to understand SOPs and be able to clearly communicate with other team members
* Excellent organization skills and ability to multitask and work collaboratively and independently
* Ability to perform physically demanding work such as moving and lifting up to 50 lbs, and standing for long periods of time
* Punctuality and dependable attendance are essential

Pay rate is upon experience.

Job Type: Full-time Pay: $28.00 - $30.00 per hour

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Schedule:**

* 8 hour shift (Day shift)

Join us in ensuring the highest standards of quality across our manufacturing processes! Your dedication will help deliver exceptional products that meet stringent industry requirements while advancing your career in a vibrant, supportive environment focused on excellence.

Pay: $26.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
